messages:
clare_csm: Quick heads-up — MeridianCorp renewal next week. Procurement wants invoice to 'Meridian EU SAS' and will use a delegated procurement signer. CFO OOO until Fri. Can we confirm whether delegated e-sign will bind?
ben_cs: Do we have the new vendor code + VAT number so legal can patch the amendment?
sam_finance: Vendor code MER-EU-442, VAT: FR998877665, PO: M-4432. Invoices net30 to accounts@meridian.eu. Need billing contact on the contract.
ryan_sales: Customer also requested a 10-month term vs 12. Pricing changes slightly — will that block procurement?
sam_finance: 10mo prorated total = EUR 29,400. Finance ok with net30. Include VAT field (reverse-charge flag) on invoice.
olga_legal: Delegated signing accepted if they provide a delegation letter referencing procurement contact and delegation ref. Add signature clause: "Authorized signatory under delegation ref: <ref>" and put attestation checkbox on the envelope. Also prefer "execution date" wording.
clare_csm: Next steps: 1) @ben_cs attach delegation letter + vendor info 2) @olga_legal review amendment 3) @docusign_bot create envelope routing: procurement_delegate -> sam_finance -> olga_legal. Need checkbox text: "I confirm authority per delegation letter". Target: send today to hit onboarding kickoff.
docusign_bot: Draft envelope created: env_MC_442. Routing set to: procurement_delegate -> sam_finance -> olga_legal. Checkbox placeholder added. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_MC_442
ben_cs: Uploaded delegation_letter_2024.pdf and amendment_v2.pdf (includes entity swap + KMS fingerprint as customer requested).
olga_legal: Quick edit: replace "signature date" with "execution date" and add delegation ref DL-MC-07. Approved.
docusign_bot: Envelope env_MC_442 updated and sent to procurement_delegate at 2024-11-02T14:10:00Z.
docusign_bot: Signature event: procurement_delegate signed at 2024-11-02T14:28:12Z. Next recipient: sam_finance.
sam_finance: Signed and uploaded final invoice PDF with VAT fields and billing contact accounts@meridian.eu.
docusign_bot: Signature event: sam_finance signed at 2024-11-02T14:46:05Z. Next: olga_legal.
olga_legal: Final review done, signed at 2024-11-02T15:02:33Z. Envelope complete. Final PDF: https://docusign.example/env/env_MC_442/final.pdf
ryan_sales: Customer confirmed VAT docs uploaded to their portal and said onboarding can start after procurement sign.
clare_csm: Renewal executed — updating tracker and scheduling onboarding kickoff for 2024-11-08. Thanks all :rocket:
